QuestInfo.name: Kaiserium Grows Legs
QuestInfo.2: Thankfully #b#p3001100##k was holding onto it... You should be more careful next time.

0.0: Are you well, #b#h0##k?\r\n#L0##bSure, feeling pretty good, thank you... What are you doing here?#l\n#k
0.1: Oh, I just thought I'd come and see how the Kaiserium was holding up. You do have it, don't you?\r\n#L0##bOf course! It's right... Uh... maybe under the... no... It's gone!#l\n#k
0.2: You need to take better care of that sword. It is not a toy!\r\n#L0##bI'm  sorry, I'm sorry. What do we do?#l\n#k

yes.0: I'll be waiting for you in #b#m401040000##k. Hurry it up.

no.0: You're pretty calm for someone who lost a legendary treasure. I guess you don't need my help.

1.0: You're here. One of our soldiers found this in a garbage behind the kitchen.\r\n#L0##b(It's the #t1402198#!)#l\n#k
1.1: I'm disappointed in you, #b#h0##k. Very disappointed. Are you out of your mind? The value of this sword is immeasurable...\r\n#L0##bI'm so sorry. This was all my fault.#l\n#k
1.2: I suppose you've learned your lesson. Just don't let it happen again. That blade belonged It belonged to the previous Kaiser. Do you understand?\r\n#L0##bYes. Just don't stare at me with your evil scary eyes any more.#l\n#k
1.3: Here it is. Please make sure this never happens again.

yes.0: Now go collect #b5 samples of #t4033767##k to lift the curse,
